description: This file defines the ApiProvider class, responsible for creating, caching, and invalidating various API instances (e.g., OcsAPI, NotesAPI, FilesAPI, ShareAPI) used in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages API cache lifecycle, API instantiation with appropriate configurations, and references to external APIs such as Retrofit and NextcloudAPI.

classes.name: ApiProvider
classes.description: Singleton class managing creation, caching, and invalidation of various API instances used for server communication within the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ApiProvider.

methods.name: getOcsAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and caches an OcsAPI instance for the given account.

methods.name: getNotesAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and caches a NotesAPI instance, with optional API version preference.

methods.name: getFilesAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and caches a FilesAPI instance.

methods.name: getShareAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and caches a ShareAPI instance.

methods.name: getNextcloudAPI
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create and cache a NextcloudAPI instance for a specific account.

methods.name: invalidateAPICache
methods.description: Invalidates the API cache for a specific account.

methods.name: invalidateAPICache
methods.description: Invalidates the entire API cache for all accounts.
